description: Gera o DANFSe oficial da NFS-e Nacional e calcula automaticamente CBS/IBS/ISS usando as tabelas oficiais MIT da Receita Federal (Base V0073 — 170 cClassTrib, reduções legais de construção civil 50%, saúde 60%, educação 60%, cesta básica 100%, Simples Nacional e transição 2026–2033) no Cloudflare Edge sem servidor Java ($0.005 USDC via x402 on Base ou B2B API Key).

aliqCbs.description: Optional manual override for nominal CBS rate (%). Alias: cbsAliquota, aliq_cbs.

aliqIbs.description: Optional manual override for nominal IBS total rate (%). Alias: ibsAliquota, aliq_ibs.

aliqIbsMun.description: Optional manual override for nominal Municipal IBS rate (%).

aliqIbsUf.description: Optional manual override for nominal State IBS rate (%).

anexoSimples.description: Simples Nacional Annex (I-V) when regime='simples_nacional' (alias: anexo_simples).

ano.description: Calendar year for LC 214/2025 transition schedule (2026..2033, default: 2026).

atividadeSimples.description: Official RFB Simples Nacional activity code ('01'..'14', '90').

cClassTrib.description: Official 6-digit Receita Federal cClassTrib code (Base V0073, e.g. '200046' construction 50% reduction, '200029' health 60%, '200028' education 60%, '200003' basic food basket 100%, '200052' regulated professions 30%, '000001' standard). Alias: c_class_trib.

fatorR.description: Payroll/revenue ratio (0..1) for Simples Nacional Annex III vs V (threshold 0.28). Alias: fator_r.

generateHtml.description: Include printable DANFSe HTML in response (default: true on /generate, false on /calculate).

itens.description: Optional batch list of items/services to compute official RTC reductions and totals in a single call (max 50).

nbs.description: Optional 4-9 digit NBS service code for automatic official RFB cClassTrib lookup

ncm.description: Optional 4-8 digit NCM code for automatic official RFB cClassTrib & reduction lookup

prestador.description: Service provider identification (cnpjCpf, razaoSocial, municipio, uf, simplesNacional)

rbt12.description: Last 12-month gross revenue in BRL for Simples Nacional effective DAS rate (default: 360000).

regime.description: Tax regime (default: 'regime_regular'). Supports Simples Nacional DAS simulation and transferable B2B credit.

servico.description: Service values, cTribNac, cClassTrib, nbs, ISS and optional manual CBS/IBS rates

setor.description: Semantic sector alias when cClassTrib is unknown (e.g. 'construcao_civil', 'saude', 'educacao', 'cesta_basica', 'profissao_intelectual', 'locacao_imoveis', 'bares_restaurantes', 'combustiveis', 'padrao').

tomador.description: Service taker identification (cnpjCpf, razaoSocial, municipio, uf)

valorServico.description: Service or item amount in BRL (alias: valor_servico, baseCalculo)

xml.description: Raw NFS-e XML (National standard or ABRASF)

name: generate_danfse_rtc
